search_text: published ZDI-25-934 ZDI-CAN-26144 MindManager Attachment Insufficient UI Warning Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2025-10-07 7.8 AV:L/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['MindManager'] ['MindManager'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of MindManager. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The specific flaw exists within the handling of attachments. When opening an attachment, the user interface fails to warn the user of unsafe actions. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of current user. Fixed in version 25.0.208 ['2025-03-10 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2025-10-07 - Coordinated public release of advisory', '2025-10-07 - Advisory Updated'] AspiringYoungMan https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-25-934/
title: MindManager Attachment Insufficient UI Warning Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of MindManager. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The specific flaw exists within the handling of attachments. When opening an attachment, the user interface fails to warn the user of unsafe actions. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of current user.
